body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#782, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. 

## Problem
`test_validity` in discover mode returns `no-retained-evidence` / `source: none` when no provider run has produced receipts. Adopters call it per spec for weeks and get hundreds of identical abstentions. Nothing tells them that a provider (such as the JS test provider) must wrap their normal runs, or where it expects receipts.

## Proposal
When discover mode finds no evidence, the abstention includes:
- the producer command(s) that would create it;
- the expected evidence path;
- whether a qualification for that provider exists on this host;
- the age of the newest receipt for the repository, if any.

## Acceptance criteria
- An abstention with `source: none` always names at least one producer and one expected path.
- If receipts exist but for another revision, the reason is `stale-evidence` with the receipt revision, not `no-retained-evidence`.
